_comment: CPU instruction and memory ceilings for the coverage-ledger calls that matter on other contracts' hot paths. Measured natively by the resource-budget tests in contracts/coverage-ledger/src/test.rs, with about 20% headroom over the cost on 2026-11-21. Raise a ceiling deliberately, in the commit that needs the room, so growth is argued for rather than absorbed. is_covered and post_reserve raised 2026-11-26 (249639 and 309575 measured + ~20% headroom) for issuer-delegate, native-supply, and alias features merged from main.
